(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing specifies zinc plating without allowing for the added coating thickness. The plating will build up inside the hole and can cause interference with the mating shaft; the designer should either increase the bore size to compensate for the plating thickness or add a note requiring reaming/masking after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying the pre-plating bore size to allow for I.Z.B.P. thickness, or require the hole to be masked during plating or reamed after plating."}]}
